pricing._source: Gemini 2.5 Flash standard rate (<=200K-token prompts), 2026; see reports/token_comparison.md

_notes: provider/model are config-driven here, never hardcoded in code (D6). Change 'model' to any provider model id to switch (e.g. gemini-3.5-flash, gemini-3.1-pro); confirm the exact id in Google AI Studio. 'pricing' (USD per 1M tokens) is config-driven too so cost = logged tokens x these rates is reproducible; update it to match the configured model. The gatekeeper is provider-agnostic. The API key is NEVER stored here: it is read from os.environ via the var named by 'api_key_env' (loaded from a gitignored .env on the manual real run).
